question: Is there any doubt about presence within the middle of every cosmic egg?
premises: Presence is affirmed in the middle of each Brahma-egg.
The speaker states this as a collective standing.
inference: There is no doubt that they stand in the middle of every cosmic egg.
uncertainties: The shift to first-person plural tiṣṭhāmo may indicate multiple forms.
plain_english: Indeed, we stand in the middle of each cosmic egg; there is no doubt about this.
